blocks.text: Isaiah 15’s announcement against Moab appears within a wider stretch of Isaiah that addresses foreign nations as well as Judah and Israel. Across the book, nations and empires are portrayed as accountable, even when they function as instruments within its larger vision; elsewhere, Isaiah also looks toward nations learning, worshiping, and sharing in restoration. This broader pattern keeps Moab’s devastation from being read as the book’s final word about all nations.
